Asking on behalf of my mother. She’s been experiencing pain in her neck for many months now and still hasn’t gotten a proper diagnosis despite so many trips to the hospital. 

Initially the pain was rather mild, and not as frequent. She went to the ENT specialist, and they found nothing after an X-ray. They sent her home with omeprazole, thinking it could be acid reflux. The omeprazole didn’t help, and she went back to the hospital, this time they made her do a CT thyroid scan. They found 2 nodules on her thyroid, one 0.4cm and one 1cm wide. The doctor said at this point there was nothing they could do, and told her to come back in 6 months’ time to check on the nodules again. They also did an endoscopy and found nothing. Again, they gave her omeprazole and some Difflam gargle. She still experienced some mild pain some days, but it wasn’t too bad. 

Fast forward 2 months later to early October, she suddenly experienced intense pain like she has never experienced before in the left side of her neck. It’s the kind of pain that renders her unable to move or speak. She would clutch at her neck and scrunch her face in pain. She describes the pain as one that shoots up to her jaw. It lasts for about 10-15 seconds each time, and after that she’s completely fine. No traces of pain anywhere. And this same pattern occurs about at least 10+ times in one day. We brought her to another hospital, and they said it might be a pinched nerve. They gave her gabapentin and a ton of painkillers (paracetamol, tramadol, etoricoxib) and famotidine and gave her a follow-up appointment to the neurologist. 

She’s been taking these medicines for 4 days now and has seen no improvement in the pain. The painkillers don’t help as well. Her appointment with the neuroscience department isn’t until November and she doesn’t think she can tolerate the pain till then. I’m very worried about her. 

What could the problem be?
